notes: Quickhack descriptions are now a single compact card with no repeated title, category, patch label, legacy market section, or Final Balance block.
Canonical tier prices are enforced in FEHA item data and mirrored into dnd5e system price when that field exists: Mk.I €$2,500; Mk.II €$6,000; Mk.III €$15,000; Mk.IV €$35,000; Mk.V €$80,000.
Quickhack lookup now recognizes old names, original library names, identifiers, and source filenames so legacy world items are renamed/migrated reliably.
The loader forces a final GM-side Quickhack migration after V3 installation so stale world and owned copies cannot keep old cards/prices/names.
All 20 canonical Quickhacks have runtime handlers; DM-run effects remain chat/manual by design, while automatic effects use the silent authority layer.
